process_notes.monday_file_uploads: STANDARD UPLOAD PATH (18 Jul 2026): POST the PDF to the Make webhook https://hook.eu2.make.com/557y1gyf7jpicvlrjcpsfefxatx1fn33 (scenario 9543311 "Claude - Upload PO PDF to Monday File Column", team 983389, uses Monday connection 13883235). JSON body: item_id, board_id, column_id, file_name, file_base64 (base64 -w0 of the PDF). Response returns asset_id + public_url = proof of a genuine native asset. NEVER use the MCP get_asset_upload_url/finalize_asset_upload flow - it strands files in the pending bucket with malformed column entries that break Monday email automations (attachment silently missing). If the webhook is down, fall back to asking Daniela for an API token and use /v2/file add_file_to_column multipart.
process_notes.never_cancel: NEVER suggest or hint at cancelling an order - ever (Daniela, Jul 2026). If the routed supplier can't supply, try the next supplier per the range rules. If a secondary supplier also refuses and there is no next supplier, do NOT propose cancellation: set status 'Needs Review', leave branch/email unfilled, and post an update telling staff to speak to a manager to find a way to fulfil it - Natasha first; if unavailable, Daniela; then John.
